desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct the combined string $T = S + \# + \text{reverse}(S)$, ensuring $\#$ is a character not in 'A'-'Z'.
Compute the KMP failure function (pi array) for the string $T$.
Determine the length of the longest palindromic suffix of $S$ using the last value of the pi array.
Construct the result by appending the necessary characters from $\text{reverse}(S)$ to $S$ to form the shortest palindrome.
Print the resulting palindrome to standard output.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
If all samples pass, the task is complete.
